peaks.title: Plastic modulation of PTSD resting-state networks and subjective wellbeing by EEG neurofeedback
peaks.transformation: None — originally reported in MNI space
peaks.contrast: Regression of change in calmness (Thayer subscale, post - pre neurofeedback) on change in DMN functional connectivity (z-score maps)
peaks.sourceInPaper: Text (Results, relationship between calmness and network connectivity)
peaks.notes: Resting-state before and ~30 min after a single session of EEG alpha-desynchronizing neurofeedback. Group spatial ICA in GIFT (ICASSO); second-level in SPM8, 8 mm FWHM. Analysis masked to DMN (one-sample t-test, FDR q<0.05). Threshold P<0.005 with 20-voxel extent, described as "in accordance with a cluster-extent correction according to random field theory" (fixed extent rather than computed RFT cluster p). Decrease in DMN connectivity with the left claustrum as calmness increased. Results unchanged when covarying medication status and depression. Labelling method not stated. Signs verified on rendered page.

peaks.transformation: None — originally reported in MNI space
peaks.contrast: Deactivation during left-hand motor task relative to rest (single-subject analysis)
peaks.notes: Single-subject SPM2 analyses (no group analysis because lesion locations differed); 8 mm FWHM; threshold p=0.001 FWE-corrected, 10-voxel clusters. Deactivations overlapping known default-mode regions or adjacent to the lesion were excluded. Case 9: 69-year-old woman, left supramarginal gyrus glioblastoma (2.3x2.4x3.6 cm); peak is contralesional (right). peaks.transformation: None — originally reported in MNI space
peaks.originalAnatomicalLabel: Left Sub-lobar, Extra-Nuclear (white matter tract); corresponding cortical area: Claustrum
peaks.contrast: Follow-up (6-12 months after liver transplantation) vs baseline, paired t-test: decreased axial diffusivity (Dax)
peaks.patientGroup: Minimal hepatic encephalopathy (MHE) in liver cirrhosis
peaks.notes: TBSS (FSL 5.0.4), WM skeleton FA>0.2; randomise 5000 permutations, age and sex covariates, TFCE FWE p<0.05; no smoothing stated (standard TBSS). peaks.notes: Healthy males randomised to mild (OAA/S 3, BIS 60-80) or deep (OAA/S 1, BIS 40-60) propofol sedation; single eyes-closed BOLD run with awake baseline then target-controlled infusion. peaks.title: Hypothalamus and amygdala functional connectivity at rest in narcolepsy type 1

peaks.contrast: Amygdala seed functional connectivity: NT1 > HC
peaks.notes: Seed-based rs-fMRI (EEG-fMRI in NT1 group; eyes closed, awake confirmed by EEG/video). SPM12, REST band-pass 0.01-0.08 Hz, 6x6x8 mm FWHM; full factorial 2x2 (group x hemisphere) with age and sex covariates. Seed: amygdala subregion functionally connected to the lateral hypothalamus in HC (AAL amygdala intersected with HC hypothalamic FC map). peaks.transformation: None — originally reported in MNI space
peaks.contrast: Cue2-Reward (reward integration): CUD > HC
peaks.notes: Sequential effort-based decision-making task (Cue1 prospect, Cue2 integration, choice). SPM12 preprocessing (6 mm FWHM, MNI); first-level robust regression; second-level random effects (independent-samples t-tests) in NeuroElf. AlphaSim Monte Carlo: voxel p<0.005 two-tailed plus cluster >=52 voxels for FWE p<0.05. Combined label 'Claustrum/Thalamus/'; claustrum is the named peak region of its own 58-voxel cluster (t max 5.04). Labelling tool not named; label strings (e.g., 'Culmen/Anterior Lobe/Midbrain Red Nucleus') are Talairach Daemon vocabulary, as used by NeuroElf. peaks.patientGroup: Major depressive disorder (MDD); Frequent marijuana use (MJ); MDD+MJ (combined)
peaks.notes: Passive music listening (preferred vs neutral), 3 s TR EPI, 60 slices x 2 mm; SPM8, INRIAlign motion correction, MNI normalisation, 8 mm FWHM; ART artefact rejection left 61 of 75 participants (HC=17, MDD=15, MJ=15, MDD+MJ=14). Interconnectivity of component 9 (salience: bilateral superior frontal gyri and insula) with the left claustrum/putamen cluster; combined label, cluster Kc=86, p uncorrected 0.000, p FWE 0.001. Table 4 gives one cluster with three peak-level values; statistic type not stated (reported as 'Peak level'). Labelling method not stated.

peaks.authors: Wang F.; Wang P.; Liu Y.; Zhou T.; Meng X.; Jiang J.
peaks.title: Study of rapid reorganization of visual neurofunctions with the resting-state functional MRI in pituitary adenoma patients with vision improvement after transsphenoidal surgery
peaks.transformation: None — originally reported in MNI space
peaks.contrast: Increased FC with right MT+ seed, postoperative > preoperative
peaks.groupsInContrast: Pituitary adenoma patients (paired, post vs pre surgery)
peaks.notes: Seed-based rs-FC before and ~3 days after transsphenoidal surgery in pituitary adenoma patients with vision improvement; 16 recruited, 14 analysed after motion/scrubbing exclusions. SPM8 with DPARSF pipeline, 6 mm FWHM, band-pass 0.01-0.08 Hz, nuisance regression; 8 seeds defined as 6 mm spheres from the literature (V1, V2, MT+, FG bilaterally). Paired t test post- vs pre-operative; AlphaSim correction, corrected p<0.05 with uncorrected p<0.001 and minimum 40 voxels. Seed for this cluster is right MT+. Table 4 column is 'Peak intensity' (paired t). Labelling method not stated. No claustrum in the decreased-FC table (Table 3).
